tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Look up a domain's live DNS and grade its email authentication: DMARC, SPF, DKIM (common selectors), MX, BIMI and MTA-STS. Returns each record, its status and the issues found, with a guide link per issue. A domain checked in the last few minutes is answered from that check (cached, with its age); pass refresh to look again after changing DNS.

domain.description: The domain to check, like example.com. A URL or www. host is reduced to the domain.

refresh.description: Look the DNS up again instead of answering from a check made in the last few minutes, e.g. right after publishing a record. Only once the earlier answer is a minute old.

tools.name: generate_spf_record
tools.description: Build an SPF TXT record from the services and servers that send email for a domain, with an estimate of the DNS lookups it uses against SPF's limit of 10. Computes from the arguments only; nothing is looked up or stored.

services.description: Email services that send for the domain; each adds its documented include.

ip4.description: IPv4 addresses or ranges that send, like 192.0.2.10 or 192.0.2.0/24.

ip6.description: IPv6 addresses or ranges that send, like 2001:db8::/32.

a.description: The domain's own A record sends email.

mx.description: The domain's MX servers send email.

hard_fail.description: End with -all instead of the usual ~all.

tools.name: generate_dmarc_record
tools.description: Build a DMARC TXT record and the host to publish it at, from a policy and the addresses that should receive aggregate reports. Notes what the record does not cover yet. Computes from the arguments only; nothing is looked up or stored.

domain.description: The domain the record protects, like example.com. Used for the host name and the external reporting check.

policy.description: What receivers do with failing email. Start at none while you read reports.

subdomain_policy.description: A different policy for subdomains (sp=). Leave out to use the main policy.

strict_dkim.description: Require an exact DKIM domain match (adkim=s).

strict_spf.description: Require an exact SPF domain match (aspf=s).
